themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are leveraging recent migration crises to push anti-immigration policies and rhetoric. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, France, Germany, and the UK, where parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Lega, Rassemblement National, AfD, and Reform UK are framing migration as a national security threat and demanding stricter border controls.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Spain's handling of Ceuta migration crisis, demands health alerts, and opposes migrant redistribution plans.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italy's PM Meloni and Denmark's PM Frederiksen jointly demand EU migrant return hubs outside Europe, suspending Schengen rules.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Focuses on migration as a key issue, with Marine Le Pen addressing agricultural and migration crises in speeches.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Campaigns against migration in Saxony-Anhalt, proposing stricter policies and linking migration to crime.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage criticizes UK migration policies, aligning with broader anti-immigration rhetoric in the party's Clacton by-election campaign.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Opposes Norway's handling of migration, advocating for stricter integration policies and border controls.

themes.title: Trump administration targets gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights
themes.blurb: The Trump administration in the U.S. has issued executive orders and policies targeting gender-affirming care for transgender youth and broader LGBTQ+ rights. This theme resonates in Poland and Hungary, where similar conservative policies are being debated or implemented, reflecting a transnational push against progressive gender policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Issued executive orders banning Medicaid funding for gender-affirming care for minors and targeting LGBTQ+ rights.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Debates and implements conservative policies on gender and LGBTQ+ rights, aligning with broader right-wing trends.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Promotes traditional family values and opposes progressive gender policies, mirroring U.S. conservative rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes progressive gender policies, aligning with broader conservative backlash against LGBTQ+ rights.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is leading in polls ahead of regional elections in Saxony-Anhalt, reshaping the political landscape. This surge is influencing other right-wing parties in Europe, including Sweden and Norway, where similar trends are observed.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt with 43%, facing internal conflicts and legal challenges over extremism.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Influences Swedish politics with rising support, pushing stricter immigration and law-and-order policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Monitors AfD's rise, adapting strategies to counter similar far-right movements in France.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Gains traction in Norway with policies mirroring AfD's focus on immigration and national sovereignty.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, Hungary, the U.S., and the UK are targeting social programs as part of broader fiscal debates. These governments argue for reducing public spending, privatizing services, and cutting taxes, often clashing with opposition parties and public sentiment.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government cuts social programs, privatizes healthcare, and reduces public spending amid economic crisis.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Targets social programs, including healthcare and education, to address fiscal deficits and promote conservative policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes cuts to social programs, including Medicaid and Head Start, to reduce federal spending and promote privatization.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Advocates for reducing public spending on social programs, aligning with broader right-wing fiscal policies.
